handoff.summary: Confirmed capacity-scaled spare-limb clearing dominates H1 preparation: 582 logical writes trigger 4,866,048 cleared words. The unsafe global setter change was reverted. Wired fail-closed private-buffer authority into real host-core generation: reachable calls propagate authority through renamed parameters, registered private stores omit spare clears, and root success/failure canonicalize before publication. The exact authority-wired fused replay improves preparation 16.95% and the inclusive root 13.51%, with every frozen hash/counter/root/getfu unchanged and rejected authority producing byte-identical ordinary canonical C.
risks: Global no-clear violates the public canonical IntegerBuffer ABI and must not be restored.
Results are a single diagnostic profile, not a seven-pair qualification timing series.
Broader raw-buffer cross-backend qualification is still required before enabling private authority generally.
next_steps: Poison spare limbs and compare full raw buffers across GMP, FLINT, JavaScript, and Wasm before broader promotion.
After promotion review, measure a seven-pair qualified timing series rather than extrapolating this one sample.
